rows.en: Report from the astronomy section! Tomorrow's sunrise is at 5:21.
That leaves us less than 12 hours!
Damn it… How can we save Seven?

…Hey?

All you've been talking about is Seven… What about Dan and Soga? Alien Guts took them away!

Anne… we haven't forgotten them, not for a moment!

But think about what Alien Guts means by executing Seven at dawn.
But…

Alien Guts may be trying to execute Seven right before our eyes to fill the people of Earth with despair…

That way, the people of Earth will lose the courage to fight Alien Guts and accept submission…

If that happens… that space fortress will come charging in all at once too!!

We can't let Seven die.
Then… you're saying Dan and the others should be sacrificed!?
Anne… the two of them may already have been killed.
What…
And if they are alive, that's all the more reason we couldn't strike the enemy base, isn't it?
It's using the space station's circuit, but it's not coming from the station!
All right… record it and analyze it immediately!

Oh, I knew it… I figured you'd be here! Masaru and Jiro!

Akira and Hiroshi aren't here? That's too bad.
Kotaro… where have you been?

Well, actually…

Ta-daaa!!
Whoa…!!
A handheld game console!!

Hahaha… You both wanted one, didn't you?

It's a little early for Christmas, but oh well…
Thanks, Kotaro!
Masaru, let's play a versus game!

There's something for everyone… This is for [HERO2] and [HERO4]!

And these are for my senpai…

Oh, right! There's something for you too, Oyassan! A pipe I found, a real bargain…

Wait just a second!
I don't need anything…

Kotaro…

As long as I can fight alongside you, Takeshi, Hayato, Shiro, Taki… and [HERO2] and [HERO4]… everyone who gathers here, I don't need anything…

…………

What's wrong, Oyassan? It'll be fine… We'll never let the Naager or Crisis do as they please!

Come on, please take this!

…………

Thanks…
But… why are you being so nice all of a sudden?

Hahaha… From now on, the fighting's going to get even tougher!

I probably won't get to play with you guys much, Masaru, Jiro… And I don't know if I'll be able to celebrate Christmas with everyone…

So I figured I'd hand these over while I can! And some New Year's money while I'm at it…

or so I thought, but I went overboard buying presents for everyone…
Kotaro…
Oyassan… please stay healthy, always!
Kotaro, you…

I'm giving this back…

Ah… I know! I'll quit smoking! I've been meaning to quit for ages!

Until the Earth is at peace and you come back, no more smoking!
Oyassan…

Kotaro! Come back here again! Then I'll smoke it to my heart's content!

Okay? So… come back again!

Kotaro… I'm quitting smoking…

So…

So don't you dare die! Got it?

Don't… don't throw your life away!

Kotaro…

Live… live, so we can all be together again…

Come on, Oyassan! Everyone too…

I'm going to defeat Crisis, and then defeat the Naager with all of you! I'll definitely come back!

Please forgive me… for going after Crisis on my own for a little while.
All right… let's do this! I'm off!!

He means to die…

That's why he came… to see me, to see everyone! Damn it…
Kotaro…
Ultraseven has been captured by Alien Guts! They say he's going to be executed tomorrow morning!

Those bastards… have declared war on mankind!

I won't stand for it…! The Naager have sent out Gigants too!

What!?

All right, let's hurry!!
Captain! The analysis results are in!
And?
That signal just now was coming from Seven's brain!
What!? Seven is alive?

Yes, sir!

But… he says he can't move his body without magnelium energy!
Magnelium energy… No one anywhere in the world has succeeded in synthesizing it yet…
Look at this…

Fuse four hydrogen atoms into one helium atom, and fix the energy released at that moment…

But that's a problem.
What is it?

To fuse that hydrogen, you need a diamond ore…

It's an ore from Africa… something used only in a few places even there!

I wonder if we'd find anyone who has some even if we searched all of Japan…
From Africa…?
Hm?
That's it! That's it!

What!? What does Africa have to do with me?

…!?

Ah… That's right!
Captain! The magnelium energy is complete!

Good, well done!!

Who will choose the path to ruin… the Earthlings or Alien Guts? This is our final operation!

Ultra Hawks, launch!!
Damn it… Alien Guts!
Alien Guts is in the way! First take care of the enemy, then fire the magnelium energy shell!

All right… looks like we've cleared them out for now.

Furuhashi! Aim for that beam lamp!
Captain! It hit, but I didn't feel anything!
Don't give up! There's still time before dawn! Try again!!
And then, the night ended… and the hour Alien Guts had set for Ultraseven's execution arrived…
Defeat all Clone Alien Guts!
Defeat all Clone Alien Guts and Kelbaans!
Defeat all Gigants!
Defeat all Clone Alien Guts and Gigants!
Capsule Monster Windom is defeated
Captain Kiriyama, Furuhashi or Anne Yuri is defeated
Here you go…
Thanks.
Here, big brother…
It's been a while, hasn't it? Since I had one of your coffees, Aki…
That just shows how much you've been neglecting us! You've been so cold lately…

Well… one incident after another, you know?

Even today, it's MAT work, right?
…So, how is it? That stabilizer you invented, big brother?

With this attached, the MAT Vehicle can run steady even at 200 kilometers an hour!!

It's all thanks to you, Mr. Sakata.

uncertain: U15310/U15312: Chief of Staff Takenaka's reasoning to Anne kept at full harshness.
U15323: 先輩たち rendered 'my senpai' (Kotaro's elder Riders).
U15330: お年玉 rendered 'New Year's money'.
U15334/U15336: Tobei returns the pipe and vows to quit smoking until Kotaro returns; 'smoke it to my heart's content' refers to the pipe.
U15342: narration row begins mid-quote; reads as Taki's report (continues in U15343).
U15358: Furuhashi remembers the African gem from U15198-U15200 (the subject of the realization is implied).
U15367/U15368/U15370: 化算密宙判ガッツ優判 is a badly garbled 分身宇宙人ガッツ星人; rendered 'Clone Alien Guts' as in B0190.
U15375/U15379: お兄さん is Aki's actual older brother Ken Sakata (coffee served to Go in U15373, then to Ken); Ken invented the stabilizer.
U15380: 坂田さん = Ken Sakata, who answers in U15381 (he designed the stabilizer); Go addresses him directly.

glyph_suspects.likely: 分身宇宙人ガッツ星人/全て
